# LCARdS

> LCARdS is a Star Trek LCARS-style card system for Home Assistant: custom Lovelace cards (button, elbow, slider, chart, data grid, select menu, layout card, alert overlay, MSD ship displays), a layout view and a shell dashboard strategy, configured in YAML, with themes, rules, data sources, animations, sounds and an alert mode.

These docs describe LCARdS 2026.11.0-dev.1. When writing LCARdS YAML, use only keys from the JSON Schemas below (do not invent keys), then check the result with the config checker. Every LCARdS card type is written as `type: custom:<name>` (for example `custom:lcards-button`).

## Machine-readable

- [Schema index](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/schema/index.json): one JSON Schema per card, view and strategy, the shared files each uses, and their sizes; load only the card you need
- [Full schema bundle](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/lcards-schema.json): every schema in one file (about 470 KB)
- [Built-in names](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/schema/registries.json): presets, components, animation and background presets, filters, sound assets, MSD backgrounds and theme tokens that values must match
- [Config checker](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/tools/lcards-validate.mjs): `node lcards-validate.mjs dashboard.yaml` checks a card, view or whole dashboard (Node 20+, one file)
- [All user docs in one file](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/llms-full.txt): getting started, configuration, cards and core as markdown
- [LCARdS skill](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/tools/lcards-skill.zip): instructions plus all of the above in one package (Agent Skills format: Claude Code, claude.ai and other compatible tools)
- [Claude Code marketplace](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/marketplace.json): the same skill as a Claude Code plugin (`/plugin marketplace add https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/marketplace.json`, then `/plugin install lcards@<marketplace name>`)
- [Getting AI help](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/ai-assistance.html): what to attach and a prompt template

## Getting started

- [Getting AI Help](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/ai-assistance.html): Get Claude, ChatGPT or another AI assistant to write LCARdS YAML that works: the LCARdS skill for Claude, what to give other assistants, and how to check the result.
- [Building a Dashboard](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/building-dashboards.html): How to compose an LCARS dashboard from LCARdS cards: which card for which job, laying out a screen on a layout view, and recipes for rules, data sources and alert mode.
- [Coming from CB-LCARS](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/cb-lcars-migration.html): Moving from CB-LCARS to LCARdS: the LCARdS equivalent of each CB-LCARS card and feature, and what is new.
- [Check Your Config](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/config-checker.html): Paste LCARdS YAML (a card, a view or a whole dashboard) and see every unknown option, misspelt name and invalid value, with its line and a link to the docs. Runs in your browser.
- [Dashboard Gallery](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/dashboard-gallery.html): Sample LCARdS screens showing layouts and the LCARS look (bridge, engineering, environmental, security, alert mode, Picard-era operations and sciences screens, and ten screens built from the...
- [Getting Help](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/getting-help.html): Something not working in LCARdS? Check your config, run the health check in the LCARdS Config panel, look through common problems, then report an issue with your support info filled in.
- [Installation](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/installation.html): Install LCARdS from the Home Assistant Marketplace (HACS), add the integration (Home Assistant 2026.11 or newer) and set it up from the LCARdS Config panel.
- [Designing LCARS Screens](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/lcars-design.html): Guidelines for making a Home Assistant dashboard look like LCARS: frames, colour roles from your theme, the Picard and classic looks, motion, and the screen archetypes to start from.
- [LCARS Patterns](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/lcars-patterns.html): LCARS patterns to compose a screen from, each a live LCARdS card or layout card coloured by theme role: code-block columns, toggle tabs, sweeps and frames, utility pills, pill grids, gauges,...
- [Live Demo](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/live-demo.html): LCARdS running live, by topic: astrometrics scenes, WebGL backgrounds, grid surfaces, charts, data grids, alerts and animation, as real cards you can try.
- [What is LCARdS?](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/getting-started/what-is-lcards.html): What LCARdS is: LCARS-style cards, a layout view and a shell dashboard for Home Assistant, with themes, rules, data sources, animations, sounds and alert modes, and how the pieces fit together.

- [Persistent Helpers](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/configuration/persistent-helpers.html): Every Home Assistant helper LCARdS uses (alert mode, sounds, Alert Mode Lab colours, HA-LCARS sizing) with its type, default and purpose, how to create them from the Config Panel or by hand, and...

## Cards

- [Alert Band](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/alert-overlay/band.html): Alert overlay band (display: band): a row of dashes in the alert colour across the screen with the alert symbol in the middle, leaving the dashboard usable.

- [Chart Card](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/chart/): Chart card: plot Home Assistant sensors over time as lines, areas, columns, gauges, range bands and more, from entity history, long-term statistics or LCARdS data sources.
- [Examples](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/chart/examples.html): Complete chart card examples to copy: a weather panel with two Y axes, a fortnight of daily energy from statistics, a power monitor with average and peak, and a smoothed temperature from an LCARdS...

- [Chart Playground](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/chart/playground.html): Edit the YAML and the chart redraws as you type. Pick a starting point from the list, or paste a chart from your own dashboard.
- [Series and Time](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/chart/series.html): Chart card series: where the data comes from (entity history, long-term statistics, LCARdS data sources), series options, the time window, grouping into time buckets, and several Y axes.
- [Styling](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/chart/styling.html): Chart card styling: colours, lines, fills, markers, grid, fonts, ApexCharts theme, animation presets and raw ApexCharts options.
- [Chart Types](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/chart/types.html): Chart card types with examples: time charts (line, area, column, bar, scatter, heatmap), current-value charts (gauges, pie, donut, polar area, radar, treemap), range charts (range area, box plot,...
- [Upgrading](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/chart/upgrading.html): Chart card upgrades: how older chart configs (source, seriesnames, seriesN data sources) keep working and are converted to sources, and how apexcharts-card options map to lcards-chart.
- [Common Card Properties](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/common.html): Options every LCARdS card takes: id and tags for rules, variables for templates, height and width overrides, overflow, zindex and gridoptions.
- [Data Grid Card](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/data-grid/): Data grid card: a grid of LCARS cells, either generated values with the colour cascade or your own rows of text, entity states and templates.
- [Data and Cells](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/data-grid/data.html): Data grid card cells: decorative values, rows, what a cell can show (text, entity states, templates, data sources), cell objects, header rows, conditional colours and tap actions.
- [Data Grid Playground](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/data-grid/playground.html): Edit the YAML and the grid redraws as you type. Pick a starting point from the list, or paste a grid from your own dashboard.
- [Styling and Animation](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/data-grid/styling.html): Data grid card styling and animation: style layers from grid to cell, style keys, header rows, CSS Grid layout, the LCARS colour cascade, highlighting changed cells and filters.
- [Upgrading](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/data-grid/upgrading.html): Data grid card: older configs (random/template modes, numeric grid sizes, the animation block, cellStyles) and the current keys they become.
- [Elbow Card](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/elbow/): Elbow card: the LCARS corner bars, caps, slanted bars and frames that give a dashboard its shape, with text on the bars, actions and an optional embedded card.
- [Colour, Text and Effects](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/elbow/appearance.html): Elbow card colour, text and effects: fill colours and state maps, text on the bars and in the open area, shape textures and background animations fitted inside the bars.
- [Bars and Curves](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/elbow/bars.html): Elbow card bars and curves: simple and segmented styles, bar sizes, corner curve keywords, paired elbows, diagonal cuts and HA-LCARS theme sizes.
- [Frames](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/elbow/frame.html): Elbow card frames: type frame draws a rectangular border of two to four sides, with a thickness per side, curves per corner and an optional inner ring.
- [Elbow Playground](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/elbow/playground.html): Edit the YAML and the card redraws as you type. Pick a starting point (a header or footer elbow, or the segmented style), then change the elbow type, bar sizes or colours.
- [Symbiont](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/elbow/symbiont.html): Elbow card symbiont: embed any Home Assistant card in the elbow's open area, place and size it, and imprint colours, fonts and corner radii on it to match.
- [Layout Card](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/layout-card/): The LCARdS Layout Card (custom:lcards-layout-card): a CSS Grid of cards inside one card, with the Layout Studio visual editor. Also the replacement for custom:layout-card.
- [Layout View](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/layout-view/): Layout view: a dashboard view that is one CSS grid, built and edited in place on the dashboard, compatible with lovelace-layout-card's grid-layout.
- [Main Engineering](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/main-engineering.html): Main Engineering is a tab in every LCARdS card editor. It is a live window into the systems behind the card: its data sources, rules, theme tokens and templates, and where each of its values comes...
- [MSD Card](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/): The LCARdS MSD card (custom:lcards-msd-card): a Master Systems Display. Home Assistant cards placed on a ship blueprint or floor plan, joined by routed lines, with shapes, animations and rules.
- [Animations and Rules](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/animations.html): MSD card animations and rules: animate parts of the blueprint, animate a whole group of overlays with one entry, and restyle overlays, play animations and tint the blueprint with rules.
- [Background and Anchors](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/background.html): MSD card background and anchors: the msd block, the base SVG blueprint and its sources, the view box, a blank canvas, named anchors, the anchors found in the blueprint, and an animated background.
- [Base SVG Filters](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/base-svg-filters.html): MSD card base SVG filters: dim, blur, desaturate or tint the blueprint with CSS filters and SVG filter primitives so the overlays stand out, with recipes to copy.
- [Control Overlay](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/control-overlay.html): MSD control overlay: put any Home Assistant card on the MSD canvas, place it by coordinates, anchor or another control, and connect lines to its attachment points.
- [Line Overlay](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/line-overlay.html): MSD line overlay: join controls, shapes and anchors with routed lines; sides, gaps, routing modes, corners, stroke, dashes, markers and colours that follow entities.
- [Manual Routing](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/manual-routing.html): MSD manual routing: draw a line through waypoints you choose, coordinates or anchor names, with a corner radius per waypoint.
- [Getting Started](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/quick-start.html): Build a first MSD card in the MSD Studio without writing YAML: add the card, pick a blueprint, place a control and connect it to the ship with a line. Then a complete example to copy.
- [Line Routing](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/routing.html): How MSD lines find their path: obstacles, automatic bundling, channels, crossing avoidance, routing modes, corner size, the card-wide routing settings and debugging.
- [Shape Overlay](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/msd/shape-overlay.html): MSD shape overlay: rectangles, circles and polylines for rooms, zones, walls and conduits, with fills and colours that follow entities and points lines can attach to.
- [Select Menu Card](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/select-menu/): Select menu card: an inputselect or select entity as a grid of LCARS option buttons, or a manual menu of buttons with their own actions.
- [Grid and Sizing](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/select-menu/layout.html): Select menu card grid and sizing: columns, gaps, row height and flow, how many rows the card asks for in a sections view, and the fit and 100% height modes for menus inside layouts.
- [Options and Actions](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/select-menu/options.html): Select menu card options and actions: which options show and in what order, labels, icons and per-option styles, and what tap, hold and double-tap do.
- [Select Menu Playground](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/select-menu/playground.html): Edit the YAML and the card redraws as you type. Pick a starting point (options from an inputselect, or custom labels), then change the preset or the grid.
- [Styles](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/select-menu/styles.html): Select menu card styles: background, text and border colours for selected and unselected options, the buttontemplate for any other button key, which text fields show, rules and a full example.
- [Slider Card](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/slider-card/): Slider card: interactive sliders and read-only gauges for lights, covers, fans, climate, media players and sensors, as pill bars, ruler gauges, shaped fills and ring gauges.
- [Ring, Shaped and Picard](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/slider-card/components.html): Slider card ring gauge, shaped fills and Picard gauge: angles, thickness, scale, value markers, centre text, shapes and colours.
- [Control and Motion](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/slider-card/control.html): Slider card control: what each entity domain controls, min, max and step, read-only sliders, value easing (valuetween) and the drag value badge.
- [Slider Playground](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/slider-card/playground.html): Edit the YAML and the card redraws as you type. Pick a starting point (a brightness pill bar, a temperature gauge or a number level), then change the preset or the entity.
- [Ranges and Markers](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/slider-card/ranges.html): Slider card ranges: coloured value bands and live value markers with captions, on pill bars, gauges and ring gauges.
- [Pills and Gauges](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/cards/slider-card/styles.html): Slider card pill bars and ruler gauges: track, segments, tick marks, scale labels, the value indicator, border caps and text labels.

## Core features

- [Features](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/): What every LCARdS card can do (actions, colours, text, animations, sounds) and the shared services behind them (themes, rules, data sources, templates, alert mode).
- [Actions](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/actions.html): LCARdS card actions: tapaction, holdaction and doubletapaction with toggle, perform-action, navigate, more-info, url and assist, plus hover effects and the cursor.
- [Alert Mode](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/alert-mode.html): LCARdS alert mode: red, yellow, blue, gray and black alert recolour every dashboard at once, play the alert sound and raise the alert overlay.
- [Entity Change Triggers](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/animations/entity-change-triggers.html): onentitychange animations: play when an entity changes, gate on fromstate and tostate, loop while a condition holds (while), check on load, watch an attribute such as brightnesspct, and follow a...
- [Animation Preset Reference](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/animations/preset-reference.html): Every built-in animation preset, with the keys it takes and their defaults. Pick a preset with preset: on an entry in a card's animations list (Animations), and give its own keys under params.
- [Rule-based Animations](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/animations/rule-based-animations.html): Rule-based animations: start animations on any number of cards when a Rules Engine rule matches, target them by id, tag, type or pattern, and stop them when it no longer matches.
- [Timing and Easing](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/animations/timing-and-easing.html): Animation timing and easing: duration, delay, loops and alternate, numbers that follow an entity with maprange, anime.js v4 easing curves and springs, and reduced motion.
- [Triggers](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/animations/triggers.html): Animation triggers: play an animation on a tap, double tap or hold, on hover, once on load, each time a card appears (onshow), on an entity change or on a data source update.
- [Card Animations](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/animations.html): Card animations: presets that pulse, glow, slide and draw a card or parts of it, played on a tap, when a view opens, when an entity changes or from a rule.
- [Borg Actions](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/borg-actions.html): The lcards.borgassimilate and lcards.borgdeassimilate actions: start and end the Borg assimilation from automations, scripts and buttons, on every browser or only some.

- [Rules Engine](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/rules/): Rules engine: restyle any LCARdS card, or a group of them, while a condition on entities, time or a template holds; play animations and tint an MSD blueprint.

- [Rule Examples](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/rules/examples.html): Rule examples to copy: a three-level temperature alert, day and night mode on an MSD, and a multi-condition climate alert with animations and a blueprint tint.
- [Priority and Debugging](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/rules/priority.html): Rule priority, stop and enabled: which rule wins when several patch the same card, and how to see which rules apply now (Rules tab, Provenance tab, browser console).

- [Placing Text](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/text-fields-placement.html): Placing LCARdS text fields: the nine named positions, padding from the zone edges, exact pixel or percent coordinates, alignment and rotation.
- [Fonts, Colour and Backgrounds](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/text-fields-style.html): Styling LCARdS text fields: font keys, sizing text to fill its zone (fontsizepercent, capheightratio, stretch), colour by entity state, and the background box behind a bar label.
- [Zones](https://lcards.unimatrix01.ca/dev/core/text-fields-zones.html): Text field zones: the named areas each LCARdS card has (button, elbow, slider), routing a field to a zone, your own zones in px or percent, and the debugzones outlines.
